title: Divergence: lean_export.rs hard gate misses an UNDEFINED contract callee — wrong contract certifies Proven through the fuel-0 bottom (§4 mechanism 1)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Pinned: lean/Thermite/PinExportUndefinedCallee.lean (kernel-checked). collect_expr_calls filters candidates through decls.contains_key, so a callee with NO in-program definition is invisible to BOTH gate directions in export_item AND to expr_has_spec_call/tier_of. Live repro: 'fn f(x: u64) -> u64 req true ens result == mystery(x as int) as u64 fx pure { 0 }' exports Ok{FuelFreeAuto, registry=[]} instead of Err(IncompleteRegistry([mystery])); the emitted theorem carries Expr.specCall "mystery" at fuel 0 (intVal bottom 0), lake kernel-ACCEPTS it, LeanEngine::discharge returns Proven for a contract about an undefined symbol. Authority: proof-backends.md §4 mechanism 1 (full expression-position principle: EVERY expression the export denotes against R_item contributes its spec-calls).
